meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊想法问成一份可照做的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望在动手写代码前先得到一个清晰、完整、可执行的实施步骤。
copy.tagline_en: Turn vague ideas into an actionable development plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear, executable plan before writing any code.

howto.what: Claude 会以规划顾问 Prometheus 的身份工作:只读探索代码库,先探索、只在必要时向你提问,等你明确同意后写出一份决策完整、可直接执行的工作计划;全程不改产品代码、不做实现。
howto.when: 只有你本人明确要求时才接管:说出「ulw-plan」「ulw plan」「/skill:ulw-plan」等,或用自己话要求在写代码前先做计划;它不会自行激活。

say.text: ulw-plan:给 /login 加每 IP 每分钟 5 次的限流
say.note: 进入计划模式,先只读探索再出计划

say.text: 帮我规划把用户认证改造得更安全
say.note: 意图模糊时它自行采用通行默认并说明

say.text: 先访谈我,再帮我拆解这个需求
say.note: 它会逐项提问,由你决定各个分叉

howto.what_en: Claude works as planning consultant Prometheus: it explores the codebase read-only, asks only what exploration cannot settle, waits for your explicit okay, then writes one decision-complete work plan. It never edits product code or implements.
howto.when_en: Activates only on your own explicit request: saying ulw-plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in your own words for a work plan before coding. A bare ulw run never self-activates it.

say_en.text: ulw-plan: add a 5-per-minute-per-IP rate limit to /login
say_en.note: Enters plan mode; explores first, then plans

say_en.text: Help me plan a safer overhaul of user auth
say_en.note: Fuzzy intent: it adopts and announces defaults

say_en.text: Interview me, then break this down
say_en.note: It asks the open forks one by one
